sources.title: Three Companies Get Sebi’s Green Light for Major IPOs: What You Need to Know

synopsis: Three companies, Pioneer Fil-Med, Tonbo Imaging India, and Functional & Innovative Foods, have received SEBI approval for their upcoming Initial Public Offerings. Pioneer Fil-Med's proposed Rs 500 crore IPO includes a fresh issue of Rs 250 crore and an Offer for Sale worth Rs 250 crore by promoters Pioneer Facor IT Infradevelopers and Aztech India. Tonbo Imaging India's IPO consists entirely of an Offer for Sale of up to 18,085,246 equity shares. Functional & Innovative Foods' IPO combines a fresh issue of up to 60 lakh equity shares and an Offer for Sale of up to 25 lakh equity shares by promoter Senthil Kumar Chinnusamy. SEBI issued its observations between September 21 and 25 after reviewing draft documents submitted between April and August.
